VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 31 tests pass, satisfying criterion (2). However, it provides no evidence that the off-by-one batch-cursor bug was actually fixed (criterion 1)—the passing tests could reflect pre-existing coverage that never exercised the off-by-one boundary. Without a regression test demonstrating the corrected cursor behavior, or a diff showing the fix, criterion (1) is unverified by admissible evidence. The only support for the fix itself is the self-report (SELF), which is insufficient.
